svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: GitOps delivery to three clouds
svg.desc: GitOps delivery to three clouds. 11 components in 5 groups. Connections: Developer to GitHub Actions (push to main); GitHub Actions to Container registry (image); GitHub Actions to Manifests repository (bump tag); Argo CD to Manifests repository (watch); Argo CD to Production clusters (sync); Users to Cloudflare (HTTPS); Cloudflare to Production clusters (traffic); Grafana to Production clusters (query).

text.tspan: Actions builds and signs, Argo CD syncs three clusters, Cloudflare fronts them, Grafana watches
